title: Example request to Unified RBAC API

blocks.text: The following examples show how to make requests to the Unified Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) API endpoints using Zscaler's Postman Collection.
The following example shows how to query roles using POST /v1/roles/query:

blocks.item: In the workspace where you added your collection, go to Collections.
Click the OneAPI folder and then click Unified RBAC > Roles.
Go to Query roles with pagination and filters.
The POST v1/roles/query request appears on the right-side pane.
Update the request body with valid query parameters, such as limit and offset.

blocks.text: When the request is successful, you receive a Status 200 OK message and a response body.
The following example shows how to query audit logs using POST /v1/auditlog/query:

blocks.item: In the workspace where you added your collection, go to Collections.
Click the OneAPI folder and then click Unified RBAC > Audit Logs.
The POST v1/auditlog/query request appears on the right-side pane.
Update the request body with valid query parameters, such as limit, offset, filters, and sort.

blocks.text: When the request is successful, you receive a Status 200 OK message and a response body.
